correctness.rationale: A complete exhaustive construction from seven Fano lines enumerates precisely 2,257 faces including empty; two independent membership procedures agree for all 16,384 subsets. The 1,121-pair nonempty face-poset matching has only one critical vertex and thirteen critical five-simplices. Every one of the 10,150 oriented Hasse cover relations is checked in an acyclic directed graph, visiting all 2,256 nonempty faces. Discrete Morse gives one zero-cell and thirteen five-cells, hence the claimed integral wedge regardless of field; independently computed mod-two boundary ranks corroborate but do not establish this homotopy conclusion.

value.rationale: This is an exact integral homotopy classification of the r=2 higher-independence complex of the Fano-plane incidence graph, the canonical highly symmetric smallest cubic graph of girth six. It lies strictly outside the tree/chordal regimes motivating the 2026 literature, and gives a substantive 13-dimensional fifth-homology rank and a full sphere wedge (not only a Betti number). The contrast to the known r=1 six-three-sphere wedge and to Petersen r=2 makes the specific invariant mathematically natural. An exhaustive standalone certificate turns a finite case into reproducible integral homotopy evidence; no broad downstream result is claimed.
